text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Isn't this great? Isn't this fun?! We<n>get to spend
the whooole day<n>celebrating!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh... Thank you, Urara. But today,<n>well...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I was so tired this morning, I could<n>barely get
myself out of bed. And the<n>weather says it's going
to rain soon...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I bring nothing but misfortune, even<n>on my birthday.
So... you should keep<n>your distance from me...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Don't you see? Your bed hugged you<n>reeeal snug
and tight.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And later, all the drops of rain are<n>coming down to
wish you a happy<n>birthday! ♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Which meeeans... I gotta do my part<n>too—to make
sure you have the best<n>birthday ever!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah... yeah! Thank you... Thanks so<n>much, Urara!
